title: Define and enforce the DNA serializer compatibility and legacy-migration policy
description: The serializer boundary needs an explicit compatibility policy for legacy verticalOffset migration and unknown JSON members. The earlier verticalOffset concern remains open for policy selection: FromLegacyOffset still clamps out-of-range legacy values before normal validation, which may silently repair malformed legacy data. This task should decide strict rejection versus explicit repair/reporting, then lock the decision with tests for valid endpoints, out-of-range values, NaN, and Infinity. Unknown JSON members likewise need an explicit open/closed/open-with-diagnostics compatibility decision. The raw-control-character writer defect has been separately completed under TSK-0164 and is no longer part of this task.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body: TSK-0164 now owns the CanonicalJsonWriter control-character implementation. This record retains only the still-unresolved legacy verticalOffset policy and unknown-field policy so task ownership is not duplicated.
